srp_fields.title: Actively exploited authentication bypass in Acme T100 local web API
srp_fields.ar_note: Authorised representative: Example Widgets EU Rep (synthetic).
srp_fields.summary: An unauthenticated attacker on the same network can call privileged endpoints of the T100 local web API. Exploitation observed in the wild (synthetic scenario).
srp_fields.user_action: Disable the local web API in Settings > Network until the update is installed.
srp_fields.measures_taken: Firmware 4.2.5 rejects requests with an empty session header and rotates installer credentials.
srp_fields.measure_details: Firmware 4.2.5, published 2026-11-11, distributed over the air; checksum listed in the vendor advisory.
srp_fields.measures_for_users: Install firmware 4.2.5 or later; if not possible, disable the local web API.
srp_fields.further_information: Indicators of compromise were shared with the concerned CSIRTs.
srp_fields.general_information: The session middleware of the local web API treats a request carrying an empty X-Session header as authenticated. Requests to /api/admin/* then run with installer privileges.
srp_fields.vulnerability_impact: Full control of heating schedules and device configuration; no access to cloud accounts.
